description: Search Google Flights for a route and dates. Returns one row per flight option with price, airlines, flight numbers, departure and arrival times, duration, stops, layovers, and emissions.

adults.description: Adult passengers, 1 to 9. Default 1. price_total is for all passengers; price_per_adult divides it.

cabin.description: economy (default), business, or first. Premium economy is not supported.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the prices, for example USD, EUR, GBP. Default USD.

dedupe.description: true (default): an option already returned for the same route and dates in this run is skipped and not charged.

departure_dates.description: One or more outbound dates, YYYY-MM-DD, up to 330 days ahead. Each date is its own search. Empty: 21 days from today.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_flights_per_search.description: 1 to 100. Default 30. The actor reads the flight list Google renders on the search page, usually 6 to 35 options.

nonstop_only.description: true: keep only nonstop options; others are left out and not charged. Default false.

return_date.description: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD. Works with one departure date only; for several dates use trip_days.

routes.description: One route per line, origin to destination, for example JFK to LAX, JFK-LAX, or New York to London. Airport codes (3 capital letters) give exact airports; a city name lets Google pick the city's airports. From Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

trip_days.description: Round trip only: days between departure and return, 1 to 60. Default 7. Ignored when return_date is set.

trip_type.description: round_trip (default) or one_way. A round trip price is the round trip total, and the row lists the outbound flights.

name: get_google_flights_fares
title: Get Google Flights fares
